summary.en: HarvestPulse 0.2.0: select and color-preview farms up to 128×128, grow crops remotely, and get animated bell/toast alerts when harvests are ready.
summary.ru: HarvestPulse 0.2.0: подсветка полей до 128×128, удалённый рост и анимированные оповещения о готовом урожае.
summary.fr: HarvestPulse 0.2.0 : aperçu coloré des champs jusqu’à 128×128, pousse à distance et alertes animées de récolte.
summary.az: HarvestPulse 0.2.0: 128×128-ə qədər rəngli tarla seçimi, uzaqdan böyümə və animasiyalı məhsul bildirişləri.

features.en: Color preview follows terrain: green valid, red oversized/overlapping, cyan already tracked; H opens a Cancel option.
Choose an individual selection bound of 16, 32, 64 or 128 blocks per side. Server validates absolute maximum, overlap and ownership.
Monitor up to eight named fields per world, with % and ready/total counts and ready-only/always/hidden modes.
100% bell indicator, slide-and-fade entrance, optional one-time sound and top-right vanilla toast.
Click HUD to edit opacity, background, size and alerts in place, or hold and drag to reposition.
Server-authoritative budgeted remote growth and progressive full-field scans, optimized for large selections.
64×64 PNG logo in Fabric Mod Menu; site catalog SVG icon; free Fabric 1.21.10 + Java 21.

changelog.en: Second beta: terrain-following green/red/blue area selection; 16/32/64/128-block size settings; duplicate-region protection; animated 100%-ready bell bar, optional sound and vanilla toast; click-to-edit/drag HUD; in-game mod icon; budgeted large-field scans. Compiled validation required; real gameplay tests still pending.
changelog.ru: Бета 0.2.0: визуальный выбор поля, размеры 16–128, уведомления, звуки, управление HUD и иконка в списке модов.
changelog.fr: Bêta 0.2.0 : sélection visuelle, limites 16–128, notifications, sons, éditeur HUD et icône dans la liste des mods.

changelog.en: First compiled server + client beta. Farm selection, 100% bell, name/mode manager, draggable HUD, bounded remote vanilla-style random ticks and authoritative progress synchronization. Compiled and metadata validated; gameplay tests are still required.
changelog.ru: Первая бета серверного и клиентского мода с удалённым ростом посевов. Тестирование в игре необходимо.
changelog.fr: Première bêta client/serveur avec croissance à distance. Test en jeu encore nécessaire.
